slot.brief: Given |f(x)| and g(x) counts for two sets, find the cardinality of the union or of a difference using Venn-style reasoning with three sets.

stem: Let finite sets $A,B,C$ satisfy $|A|=34$, $|B|=33$, $|C|=33$, $|A\cup B|=59$, $|B\cup C|=60$, $|C\cup A|=61$ and $|A\cap B\cap C|=4$. Find $|(A\cup B)\setminus C|$.
solution: $|A\cap B|=34+33-59=8$ and $|A\cap C|=|B\cap C|=6$. Thus $|(A\cup B)\cap C|=6+6-4=8$, so $$|(A\cup B)\setminus C|=59-8=51.$$
